description: Test utility functions for socket communication in Chromium's net module, including sending requests, reading data, and sending responses over StreamSocket objects.

methods.name: SendRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over a socket, verifies server received it, and sends a server response.

methods.name: ReadDataOfExpectedLength
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from a socket.

methods.name: SendServerResponse
methods.description: Sends a fixed HTTP 404 response over a socket.

methods.name: DrainStreamSocket
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from a socket into a buffer.
